text:
ana: quick sync: after yesterday's auto-fallback we got feedback that the console didn't make it obvious that the action was temporary. Ops wants TTL shown and an easy "promote back" CTA.

mike: agree. show TTL in pill like `fallback (cheaper-quant) · 4m left`. add a small clock icon.

rita: also add a 'reason detail' link that expands the exact trigger evaluation: metric name, window, value, threshold. users kept asking if it was client vs infra.

sree: telemetry requirements: emit `rollout.event` with fields `rollout_id, action, trigger_type, trigger_value, samples_count, simulated`. when simulated=true still emit but tag for filtering.

contingency-bot: contingency-bot: rollout 1741256789 triggered at 1741256810 (p95_latency=1350ms > 1200ms). routed 50/500 to fallback. logs -> https://logs/rollouts/1741256789

ana: for privacy we should hash inputs and support 'no_capture' tenants. also sampling_rate must be adjustable per-rollout.

mike: UX: small pill in header + toast for owners. 'Promote back' should be gated by a confirmation modal that explains capacity/cost impact.

sree: API idea: PATCH /rollouts/{id} body `{ "action": "revert", "simulate": true|false, "note": "string" }`. returns operation id. when simulate=true emit `simulated` flag.

rita: exportable timeline CSV is important for audits. minimal columns: ts, actor, action, trigger, simulated, samples.

ana: can we also show a tiny estimated cost delta in pill? even rough helps PMs decide.

mike: yes, show `+0.5 tokens/req (~$0.01/1k)` when known.

rita: owners: @mike UI pill + promote flow, @sree telemetry/api, @ana privacy + sampling. i'll draft a tiny mock and a tracking issue.
